overall.headline: Calm in Pacifica today, but a wet, windy storm arrives Tuesday night; Iran–US tension stays high.
overall.bluf: Nothing needs action today: no IPAWS alerts, outages or Pacifica closures, and the High Surf Advisory ends 4 AM Tuesday. NWS forecasts 1–2 inches of rain and gusts up to 40 mph from Tuesday night through Wednesday, so prepare tonight or tomorrow. Abroad, a third US carrier has reached the Middle East while Iran and Washington trade pressure, and Trump heads to China to meet Xi and possibly Putin.

changes: New: NWS forecasts 1–2 in of rain and gusts to 40 mph in Pacifica from Tuesday night, with a possible Wind Advisory and Wednesday thunderstorms.
High Surf Advisory now ends 4 AM Tuesday (yesterday's note said Monday); seas ease Tuesday, then build Wednesday.
New: USS Theodore Roosevelt reported in the Middle East, a third US carrier there.
Flights: Duffy says US flights are nearing full capacity.
Dropped as stale: Canadian base-fire death, France/Germany protests, Canary Islands migrants, Sudan grid item.

coming_up.title: Hwy 1 full maintenance closure in San Francisco
coming_up.detail: Caltrans also lists one-way traffic for drainage work near Montara today; check QuickMap before driving.

coming_up.title: High Surf Advisory expires
coming_up.detail: Waves of 20–25 ft with 25–35 ft sets at favored spots through Tuesday morning.

coming_up.title: Rain, gusty south winds up to 40 mph
coming_up.detail: NWS: 1–2 in of rain Tuesday night and Wednesday; a Wind Advisory is possible and thunderstorms may form Wednesday evening.

coming_up.title: Winter Storm Watch, Sierra and Tahoe
coming_up.detail: NWS Reno and Hanford watches run Wed 4 AM to Fri 4 AM; expect difficult mountain travel.

coming_up.title: APEC summit in Shenzhen; possible Trump–Xi–Putin meeting
coming_up.detail: The trilateral is described as in preparation; not all parties have confirmed.

home_front.summary: Storm Tue night; surf advisory ends Tue 4 AM; no IPAWS alerts.

items.title: Rain and strong winds from Tuesday night
items.detail: NWS's Pacifica forecast has 1–2 inches of rain Tuesday night and Wednesday, with south-southwest gusts up to 40 mph. The Bay Area office says a Wind Advisory is possible and storms may form Wednesday evening; heavy surf builds again Wednesday.
items.action: Charge phones and battery packs by Tuesday evening, clear storm drains near the house, and secure loose outdoor items. If a Wind Advisory or flood warning is issued, plan for a power outage and avoid coastal roads.

items.title: High Surf Advisory ends 4 AM Tuesday
items.detail: NWS keeps the advisory through 4 AM Tuesday Nov 17; swimmers should stay out of the water. Breaking waves of 20–25 ft with 25–35 ft sets at spots like Mavericks, easing Tuesday afternoon.

home_front.summary: No outages found; DreamHost maintenance finished.

items.title: DreamHost maintenance resolved Nov 13
items.detail: DreamHost reported Apache configuration updates on shared, VPS and dedicated servers completed Nov 13, 8:50 PM PST, and all services normal. No new incident listed.

home_front.summary: No Pacifica closures; Hwy 1 SF closure Mon–Tue.

items.title: Hwy 1 closed in San Francisco; one-way traffic near Montara
items.detail: Caltrans lists a full maintenance closure of Hwy 1 in San Francisco Nov 16–17, plus one-way traffic for drainage work near Montara today. Allow extra time on Hwy 1 north and south of Pacifica.

home_front.summary: Air quality good (AQI 49); no local advisories.

default.task: Before Tuesday evening, charge phones and battery packs and check flashlight batteries.
default.why: NWS expects strong winds and heavy rain from Tuesday night, which can cause short outages.

ladder.summary: Quiet today; storm arrives Tuesday night.

items.title: Winter Storm Watch for the Sierra, Wednesday to Friday
items.detail: NWS Reno and Hanford issued Winter Storm Watches for Tahoe, Yosemite, Sequoia and the eastern Sierra from Wed 4 AM to Fri 4 AM. Mountain travel will be difficult.

items.title: US flights near full capacity after FAA ground stop
items.detail: Transportation Secretary Duffy says flights are nearing full capacity after the weekend's air-traffic communications failure. Check airline status before heading to SFO.

items.title: Nvidia CEO stepped down amid chip-smuggling scandal
items.detail: Jensen Huang left the CEO role; a company called Megaspeed, linked to a suspected China spy who it says left in 2025, is at the center. Officials are discussing why it was not put on the export-control entity list.

items.title: CISA lists Check Point and UnrealIRCd flaws as exploited
items.detail: Both were added Nov 13; update affected products when patches are available.

items.title: EU sanctions about 50 Russian banks; accuses Moscow of stalling talks
items.detail: EU foreign ministers say Russia is stalling peace talks while hitting Ukraine's power plants as winter nears. Al Jazeera reports Russia proposed individual non-aggression pacts that could split NATO.

items.title: Five EU countries expected to announce Rwanda return hub
items.detail: Germany, Denmark, Austria, Greece and the Netherlands are expected to announce a deportation centre for failed asylum seekers.

ladder.summary: Trump heads to China for APEC.

items.title: Trump travels to China to meet Xi, possibly Putin
items.detail: NPR says Trump is making his second China trip this year; a three-way meeting is planned per the White House, but other parties have not confirmed.

items.title: Bangladesh clothing factories shut as workers strike over pay
items.detail: Workers demand a 30,000 taka monthly minimum wage. Garment supply delays are possible.

ladder.summary: Third US carrier in region; Gulf and Gaza tense.

items.title: Third US carrier reaches Middle East as Iran talks stall
items.detail: A US official told Al Jazeera the USS Theodore Roosevelt arrived Nov 15; the Pentagon has not confirmed. Trump says further strikes are 'quite unlikely' while Iran rejects 'no war, no peace' and sets conditions via Qatar.
items.action: If strikes resume, expect oil and shipping effects; top up the car's fuel if California gasoline prices jump.

items.title: Three tankers hit mines in Hormuz, Iran says
items.detail: Iran reports three oil tankers caught fire after striking mines. Oil is steady: WTI about $87.85 and Brent $95.06, both down about 13% on the month.

items.title: Saudi-backed Yemeni forces pull back to defend Aden from Houthis
items.detail: BBC reports troops moving from the Bab al-Mandab Strait toward Aden; Houthis say Saudi strikes killed three people Monday. Red Sea shipping risk rises.
items.action: Watch for shipping and fuel price effects.

items.title: UK, Australia, Canada, Italy urge Israel to let aid into Gaza
items.detail: The four say supplies, including 150,000 tents, are held at the borders.

items.title: Two mass shootings in South Africa leave 17 dead
items.detail: Attacks in KwaZulu-Natal and Gauteng; police have not announced motives in the BBC summary.

items.title: Jordan bans Telegram after church attack
items.detail: The ban follows a security crackdown after last month's deadly attack on a Greek Orthodox church.
